narratives.body: OneFootball reports that Martin Demichelis praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League match between Real Madrid and RB Leipzig at the Bernabeu. Yardbarker and Yahoo both headline that the RB Leipzig boss raves about Diomande before the clash.
narratives.headline: Martin Demichelis praises Yan Diomande ahead of Real Madrid clash

narratives.body: Goal.com reports that Martin Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina, noting that the player needs time.
narratives.headline: Martin Demichelis on Franco Mastantuono
